title: Database replication lag
symptoms: Replica db-replica-01 is 300 seconds behind primary. Reads from the replica return stale data.
root_cause: The replica cannot keep up: heavy writes, a long query on the replica, or a slow network.
impact: Users may see old data; failover to this replica would lose recent writes.
fix_steps: Cancel long queries on the replica.
Check network and disk IO between primary and replica.
prevention: Alert on lag and keep replica hardware equal to the primary.
